title: Berserk Casca Set
description: This ResourcePack add casca armor and sword
body:
# Berserk Casca Set
## Armor and Sword

Chestplate / Leggings / Boots / Sword are on netherite Set !!!

Helmet are on Carved_Pumpkin !!
![Item in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f2fcd66054645af965f2e117de4ce5b1e082c42.png)

**Guts set if u want ? :**

[https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/berserk-guts-set](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/berserk-guts-set)

/give @p netherite_sword[equippable={slot:"head"}]
